content_text: [1/2 @neelsomani] I'm a former Citadel quant who covered power & gas. There's constant talk about chips & memory, but power is the central bottleneck for AI. Very few people understand it, so I'm posting a canonical primer on power pricing & data centers: https://power2026.ai/ --- [2/2 @neelsomani] Thanks @samuel_spitz and @fkpxls for editing. Happy to answer any questions people have about power. The primer hit #1 on Apple Books (across all free books): https://books.apple.com/us/book/power-2026/id6795926467
